speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: You know, if I wanted to spend my Saturday nights doing this, I could have stayed in India.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Oh, stop with the fake third world crap. Your father's a gynaecologist, and you had a house full of servants.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: We only had four servants. And two of them were children.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: We have 128 assorted Penny Blossoms ready to ship.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Oh, God, we're never gonna finish in time. Who made Sheldon the boss anyway?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I believe I'm hearing some negativity on the factory floor. Penny, the labour force is a living organism that must be carefully nurtured. Any counterproductive grumbling must be skilfully headed off by management. Observe. Hey! Less talk, more work!

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Thank you. You hear any union talk, you let me know.
